params.name: Apply automatically
params.tooltip:
On: right after you build a roundabout (any one-way ring),
its junctions get smart lanes.
Off: only the Smart Lanes road tool changes lanes.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip: Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Smart Lanes writes how long its build handling and road tool took to the game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]), plus the road tool's hover diagnostics ([SQRL] PROBE lines). Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
